name: H5N1 bird flu
summary: One human H5N1 case reported in the past month; no human spread
state: WHO's human–animal interface summary (7 Oct) recorded one human H5N1 infection between 7 Sep and 7 Oct, with no evidence of human-to-human transmission; Cambodia confirmed its sixth case of 2026 on 28 Sep. No new cluster was reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Risk to the public remains low. Avoid contact with sick or dead birds.

sources.title: WHO — Influenza at the human-animal interface, 7 Oct 2026
CIDRAP — WHO reports H5N1 death among zoonotic flu cases

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.

rubric.watch: Human clusters under investigation, rising human cases, or new mammalian species spread.
